speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old woman. The patient reports a 2-month history of insidious onset left shoulder pain, worsening with extreme ranges of motion and activity. No history of shoulder trauma, neck pain, arm/hand weakness, numbness, or paresthesias. The patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus, treated with metformin and glipizide.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of diabetes and the progressive loss of range of motion, I suspect adhesive capsulitis. REQUEST TEST: Shoulder_X-Ray.
